source_documents.title: Three polymorphs of one luminogen: How the molecular packing affects the RTP and AIE properties？

reference_evidence_units.quote: CzS-CN gave a very weak emission at about 529 nm in THF solution with a PL efficiency as low as 2.1%, mainly caused by the motions of phenthiazine, cyan groups and phenyl ring
reference_evidence_units.subject: CzS-CN
reference_evidence_units.statement: Weak solution emission from motions of phenothiazine, cyano and phenyl units.

reference_evidence_units.quote: RTP lifetimes for the three polymorphs could change from 266 ms to 41 ms, then to 32 ms
reference_evidence_units.subject: CzS-CN

reference_evidence_units.quote: For crystal (A), there were three major and one minor ISC channels, while those of crystal (C) were much less with only one major and one minor, owing to the big changes of the molecular configuration.
reference_evidence_units.subject: CzS-CN
reference_evidence_units.statement: Number of ISC channels explains RTP differences.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The strong intermolecular interactions would restrict the intermolecular motions effectively and lead to the reduced non-radiative transition
reference_evidence_units.subject: CzS-CN
reference_evidence_units.statement: Packing contacts suppress nonradiative decay and prolong RTP.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the formed H-type packing mode in coupled II, originated from the more planar configuration in the long axis direction, would
reference_evidence_units.subject: CzS-CN
reference_evidence_units.statement: H-type packing gives the low efficiency of C; A/B have X-type pairs.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the lowest excited state corresponded to the destructive combination of the transition dipole moment for the individual molecule, which was optically forbidden
reference_evidence_units.subject: CzS-CN dimer
reference_evidence_units.statement: Parallel pair has a dark lowest state.

reference_evidence_units.quote: crystal (C) should give the more efficient emission than others. But actually it was not
reference_evidence_units.subject: CzS-CN
reference_evidence_units.statement: Monomer oscillator strength alone does not explain efficiency.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Motions of the phenothiazine, cyano and phenyl units quench the solution; aggregation restricts them (AIE).

reference_mechanisms.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: H-type vs X-type coupled pairs explain the polymorph efficiency differences.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Bright vs dark coupled-state transition dipoles, rather than monomer f, account for efficiency.

reference_mechanisms.label: TRIPLET_ISC_RTP_TADF
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Persistent RTP whose lifetime depends on ISC channels set by the polymorph conformation.
